title: Normalized construction data before exchange invertibility
statement: For a separated finite-type morphism f:X→S, a published constructible exceptional System A and compactification c, NormalizedData records a coefficient unit at every Stage, StageData [def-sf-verdier-exchange-data] for the literal identity of S, and the specified epsilon as a natural transformation commuting with shifts. Its dualizing comparison is the identity. The projection is natural in its first variable. It records the original ring realizations, projection normalization, tensor-unit comparisons with both normalized unitors, and coefficient comparisons with ScalarConclusion and canonical q/unit normalization. RingShiftRealization and ScalarShifts are asserted for every subsequent proof that all epsilon components are invertible; no such proof is part of this record. StageMaps.toConclusion constructs StageConclusion from that proof. The original global-duality Package, Data and Assertion definitions are relocated here verbatim. Its coefficient stages, operations and Systems are those of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], with the common-stage index of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], the coefficient changes of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] and the derived extension of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]; compactifications are those of [def-nagata-compactification]. GeometricAlternative uses the geometric fibre of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], smoothness [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and geometric connectedness [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible].

proof.text: Define StageMaps as the specified natural evaluation transpose with signed shifts. Given a proof of componentwise invertibility, use NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app and asIso, preserving the transformation literally. Define NormalizedData by the listed construction fields; these do not include invertibility. Existing definitions are relocated without changes.
